about.metaDescription: Meet Forma Estates and discover why we use AI to make it easier to see what a home could become.
about.title: There’s more to a home than a photo can show
about.intro: We’re Forma Estates. We use AI to make it easier to show what a home is—and what it could become.
about.motto: Technology that makes homes easier to understand.
about.story1: It can be hard to imagine an empty room as a home. And it’s not always easy to get a feel for room sizes from a floor plan. But once you can see the possibilities, the conversation changes.
about.story2: That’s what excites us about AI. An idea can become an image, a floor plan can become a 3D view, and a home’s photos can become a Showcase Video. You’re still the one who knows the property. We help you bring your ideas to life so you can share them with others.
about.founderText1: Frederik Fussing Nielsen founded Forma Estates in Copenhagen in 2025 and leads the company today. We’re building tools for estate agents, developers, housing associations and professional landlords.
about.founderText2: There’s always a person on the other side of a property presentation. That’s why we care more about whether someone understands the home than about how technically impressive the result looks.
about.visionText: We want to make it easier for more people to see a home’s potential—even when it still exists only on a floor plan or in an empty room.
about.missionText: We build AI tools for images, 3D and video that bring your ideas to life and make them easier to share.

clarity.title: It has to make sense
clarity.description: An image is only good if it helps someone understand the property—not just if it looks beautiful.

useful.title: It has to be useful
useful.description: You should be able to use the result in your next conversation, viewing or listing. Otherwise, we’re not done.

expertise.title: You bring the expertise
expertise.description: AI can show what’s possible, but you’re the one who knows the property and what the client needs to see.
